preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable token swapping and liquidity additions. This will stop the automatic conversion of tokens to ETH and liquidity provision, effectively freezing transaction functionality for all users except the owner who remains excluded from fees and max transaction limits.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() that controls whether automatic token swapping and liquidity addition is enabled. As the owner, an attacker can disable this functionality, which would stop the automatic conversion of tokens to ETH and liquidity provision. This effectively freezes transaction functionality for regular users while the owner remains excluded from fees and max transaction limits.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank() and call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the swap and liquify functionality.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false). 4. Verify that swapAndLiquifyEnabled is now false.
